title: Area: Pudsey
content:
GCSE science tuition in Pudsey

GCSE science tuition in Pudsey — in person between Leeds and Bradford, or online. Taught by Rod Martin — an expert science tutor and former Head of Science with over twenty years in UK classrooms.

Science tuition around Pudsey

Pudsey sits between Leeds and Bradford, which means students here go to schools on either side of that line and sit papers set by whichever board their school chose.

That split matters more than it sounds. Two friends a street apart can be revising the same physics with different required practicals and different exam wording — worth checking before anyone buys a revision guide.
